name: Exact Operation Profile of Minimal Non-Ample Classes
statement: For a conditioning-minimal non-ample class of VC dimension $k$, projection to $Z$ gives a cube for $|Z|\le k$, an antipodally punctured $(k+1)$-cube for $|Z|=k+1$, and another minimal non-ample class for $|Z|>k+1$. Every nonempty proper conditioning is a UOM fiber; consequently every nonempty pc-minor lies in either the minimal-non-ample layer or UOMFib. For a connected parent, every noncube projection in this profile remains connected.
proof: The uniform-oriented-matroid classification turns projection into deletion of a uniform matroid, giving the three projection cases. Conditioning fixes tope signs and therefore gives a topal fiber. Once a pc-minor sequence enters UOMFib it stays there by pc-minor closure; otherwise its projection steps remain in the minimal-non-ample layer. The connected qualification follows from the non-free simple UOM recognition theorem.
